task: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Launch Zotero. Locate the item titled 'A Survey of RL Methods' in the middle pane and click it. Set the 'DOI' field to exactly this value: 10.1234/rl-survey-2020. Do not wrap it in quotes or add anything else. Press Enter / click away so Zotero saves the new DOI. Leave Zotero running so the edit persists.
task_grounding: Zotero is installed and a pre-seeded library is at /home/user/Zotero/zotero.sqlite. Launch Zotero. Locate the item titled 'A Survey of RL Methods' in the middle pane and click it. In the right-hand Info pane, find the 'DOI' field (it currently has no value) and enter exactly this DOI: 10.1234/rl-survey-2020. Do not wrap it in quotes or add anything else. Press Enter / click away so Zotero saves the new DOI. Leave Zotero running so the edit persists.

cli_feasibility.translation: Python script using SQLite: 1) Find item by title, 2) Find DOI fieldID, 3) Insert/update value in itemDataValues table, 4) Link via itemData table
cli_feasibility.reason: Zotero stores item metadata in itemData and itemDataValues tables. A Python script can update field values by finding the correct fieldID and inserting a new value record, then linking it to the item. This is how Zotero itself stores metadata changes.
